keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 1, Cardiff City 0. Fer López (Wolverhampton Wanderers) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Hugo Bueno with a through ball.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 2, Cardiff City 0. Adam Armstrong (Wolverhampton Wanderers) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Rafiki Saïd with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Jordan James (Wolverhampton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Adam Armstrong (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Cardiff City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Jordan James (Wolverhampton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde replaces Jordan James because of an injury.
André (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Wolverhampton Wanderers 2, Cardiff City 0.
Fer López (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card.
Joel Bagan (Cardiff City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 3, Cardiff City 0. Ladislav Krejcí (Wolverhampton Wanderers) header from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kieran Trippier with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Rubin Colwill replaces Chris Willock.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Cian Ashford replaces Calum Scanlon.
Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Rodrigo Gomes replaces Fer López.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Mateus Mané replaces Rafiki Saïd.
Substitution, Cardiff City. David Turnbull replaces Alex Robertson.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Ronan Kpakio replaces Will Fish.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Tawanda Chirewa replaces Adam Armstrong.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Tommy Doyle replaces André.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Charlie Holt replaces Ollie Tanner.
Rubin Colwill (Cardiff City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
